mapper.select: SELECT teacher.id, teacher.username, teacher.display_name, teacher.mobile, teacher.status, MIN(school.id) AS school_id, MIN(school.organization_name) AS school_name, teacher.created_at, teacher.updated_at FROM sys_user teacher JOIN sys_user_organization teacher_membership ON teacher_membership.user_id = teacher.id JOIN sys_organization school ON school.id = teacher_membership.organization_id WHERE GROUP BY teacher.id, teacher.username, teacher.display_name, teacher.mobile, teacher.status, teacher.created_at, teacher.updated_at ORDER BY teacher.created_at DESC, teacher.id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.limit} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}

SELECT teacher_user_id, class_organization_id FROM edu_teacher_class WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher_user_id IN
#{teacherUserId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization class_organization WHERE class_organization.id = edu_teacher_class.class_organization_id
AND
class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{path}, '%')
1 = 0
) ORDER BY teacher_user_id, class_organization_id

SELECT teacher.id, teacher.username, teacher.display_name, teacher.mobile, teacher.status, MIN(school.id) AS school_id, MIN(school.organization_name) AS school_name, teacher.created_at, teacher.updated_at FROM sys_user teacher JOIN sys_user_organization teacher_membership ON teacher_membership.user_id = teacher.id JOIN sys_organization school ON school.id = teacher_membership.organization_id WHERE teacher.id = #{teacherUserId} AND teacher.user_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND school.organization_type = 'SCHOOL' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role teacher_role_assignment JOIN sys_role teacher_role ON teacher_role.id = teacher_role_assignment.role_id WHERE teacher_role_assignment.user_id = teacher.id AND teacher_role.role_code = 'TEACHER' AND teacher_role.status = 'ENABLED' )
AND (
school.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{rootPath}, '%')
)
GROUP BY teacher.id, teacher.username, teacher.display_name, teacher.mobile, teacher.status, teacher.created_at, teacher.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, mobile = #{mobile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{teacherUserId}
